test_title: PYST 18: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 16 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
‘A + B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’.

‘A / B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’.

‘A ^ B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.

‘A % B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’.

‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the son of B’.

If U ^ V / W + X % Y, how is U related to Y?
solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png]

 Meaning
 Brother
 Mother
 Husband

Given: U ^ V / W + X % Y

It means: U is the Husband of V, V is the Mother of W, W is the Brother of X, X is the Sister of Y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa19977794988d6286529e730cdb94cf6f8807dd7f277fdfe039fea88aa8fcb8.png] 

Here, U is the 'Father' of Y.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
